chapter: Fourteen years with Nat Cole and the recording sessions
title: Leaving Tatum to join Nat Cole
summary: Collins worked again with Tatum, then Nat Cole called; Tatum reluctantly let him go and he stayed about fourteen years until Cole died.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: So Art was going into some club on the east side, I can't think of it now, and he wanted me to play with him. So I promised him that I would so Slam was with him and I went with Art again. I worked with Art for quite a while and I got this call from Nat Cole to come with him. Well, I was under contract to Art, so Art gave me a little difficult time. He didn't want me to leave but finally he consented for me to leave, and I joined Nat, you know. And geez, I think I stayed with Nat for about 14 years.
You were doing that in what year?
'50, I believe, or '51. I forget. But when did he die, in '65? I stayed with him until then, you know, until he died. So -- now --
